open_points.subject: _credential_is_usable
open_points.text: _credential_is_usable: [BEHAVIOR] MUST be true only when the principal status is the active member of = models.PrincipalStatus, the credential is unrevoked, and checked_at is before expires_at when present.
open_points.question: Must the note name the declared ACTIVE member instead of the nonexistent lowercase active member?

open_points.subject: _next_key_version
open_points.text: _next_key_version: [BEHAVIOR] MUST return the successor of the greatest persisted key_version for principal_id, or the first version when none exist, within the issuing transaction.
open_points.rule:
**Fail-closed на обеих сторонах.** Неразмещённое значение останавливает
  сборку. Подстановка значения в контекст модели «на всякий случай»
  запрещена: она молча восстанавливает старое поведение и обесценивает шов.
open_points.question: The first key-version value must become an imported, typed constant named by the note, rather than an unspecified “first version” the generated code must guess.

open_points.subject: _next_key_version
open_points.text: _next_key_version: [RETURN_SHAPE] MUST derive the next key version from the credentials the repository it is given reports for that principal: the first version when there are none, otherwise the successor of the highest key_version present, counting revoked and expired credentials too so a version is never reused. It MUST NOT open, commit, roll back or close a transaction.

  сборку. Подстановка значения в контекст модели «на всякий случай»
  запрещена: она молча восстанавливает старое поведение и обесценивает шов.
open_points.question: The first key-version value must become an imported, typed constant named by the note, rather than an unspecified “first version” the generated code must guess.

open_points.subject: authorize_producer_scope
open_points.text: authorize_producer_scope: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST admit any active project for the all_projects member of = models.ProducerScopeMode and only a project with an active grant for its granted_projects member, decide before any content validation, and use trusted actor scope and active persisted grants only.
open_points.question: Must the note name the declared ALL_PROJECTS and GRANTED_PROJECTS members instead of nonexistent lowercase members?

open_points.subject: change_service_principal_status
open_points.text: change_service_principal_status: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST leave the principal and credentials it reads unmodified, since repository values are frozen instances. It MUST hand the repository replacements. Disabling an active principal replaces it with the imported revise_service_principal, passing the disabled member of = models.PrincipalStatus as new_status, the one utc_now instant as disabled_at and the staff_id of the authorized administrator as disabled_by, and replaces every credential of that principal that is not already revoked with the imported revise_service_credential, passing the same instant as revoked_at and the authorized administrator context; enabling a disabled one replaces it with revise_service_principal, passing its active member as new_status and None as disabled_at and disabled_by, and revives no credential.
open_points.question: Must the note name the declared DISABLED and ACTIVE members instead of nonexistent lowercase members?

open_points.subject: change_service_principal_status
open_points.text: change_service_principal_status: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST append, through the audit repository of that transaction, a single audit built with the imported build_staff_audit_intent from the authorized administrator context, passing as action the transition it performed — the principal.disable member of = models.AuditAction or its principal.enable member — the service_principal member of = models.AuditEntityKind as entity_kind, the principal identifier as entity_id and None as project_id. A request for the status the principal already holds changes nothing and appends no audit.

open_points.subject: create_service_principal
open_points.text: create_service_principal: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST append exactly one success audit through the audit repository of that transaction, built with the imported build_staff_audit_intent from the authorized administrator context, the principal.create member of = models.AuditAction as action, the service_principal member of = models.AuditEntityKind as entity_kind, the service_principal_id of the new principal as entity_id and None as project_id.

open_points.text: grant_producer_project: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST append exactly one success audit through the audit repository of that transaction, built with the imported build_staff_audit_intent from the authorized administrator context, the producer_grant.create member of = models.AuditAction as action, the producer_grant member of = models.AuditEntityKind as entity_kind, the grant_id of the new grant as entity_id and the validated project_id as project_id.

open_points.subject: issue_service_credential
open_points.text: issue_service_credential: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST issue a credential only when the addressed ServicePrincipal has the active member of = models.PrincipalStatus as status. A principal with any other status MUST raise AuthorizationRejected without generating a secret, inserting a credential, or appending an audit, and the open transaction MUST close.
open_points.question: Must the note name the declared ACTIVE member instead of the nonexistent lowercase active member?

open_points.subject: revoke_producer_project
open_points.text: revoke_producer_project: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST append exactly one success audit through the audit repository of that transaction, built with the imported build_staff_audit_intent from the authorized administrator context, the producer_grant.revoke member of = models.AuditAction as action, the producer_grant member of = models.AuditEntityKind as entity_kind, the revoked grant_id as entity_id and the project_id of the revoked grant as project_id.

open_points.subject: revoke_producer_project
open_points.text: revoke_producer_project: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST treat a grant as revocable only when its status is the active member of = models.GrantStatus and revoked_at is None. A missing grant or any persisted grant that fails either positive condition MUST raise the same ScopedNotFoundError without mutation or audit; the implementation MUST NOT replace the positive requirement of its active member with an enumeration of currently known non-active statuses.
open_points.question: Must the note name the declared ACTIVE member instead of the nonexistent lowercase active member?
